status: publication-control proposal grounded in current matrix semantics
purpose: Define which evidence classes may support which claim classes, how freshness and jurisdiction are rendered, and when web/client publication must block or warn.

source_classes.freshness: verify current official text before publication and whenever rulemaking/edition changes

cannot_alone_support: claim that guidance text is itself a regulation unless the source says so

examples: ANSI/ESTA and other recognized consensus standards
may_support: industry consensus requirement/recommended practice within scope
source_classes.freshness: pin exact document number, edition/year, status, publisher; recheck official standards catalog
source_classes.copyright_rule: cite/summarize within license/copyright limits; do not copy protected standard text into public course bodies

source_classes.freshness: pin manufacturer, product family/model, document revision/version
recheck official program before learner-facing credential claims

cannot_alone_support: law unless it cites primary law

source_classes.freshness: volatile; owner is Production Atlas when used as public labor-market/work-route intelligence
date/sample controlled; private analysis where personal detail exists
recompute from current Production Atlas/industry evidence

examples: knowledge completion is separate from practical/employer authorization
cannot_alone_support: claim that external law imposes the same boundary

claim_publication_states.source_complete: required direct/partial/corroborating edges present; qualifiers and review state satisfied
claim_publication_states.partial: some support exists but applicability, edition, review, or directness is incomplete
claim_publication_states.unsupported: no adequate support edge for the external claim
claim_publication_states.internal_policy_only: valid as Crew Blueprint product policy, but not presented as external law/industry fact
claim_publication_states.stale: source may once have supported claim but freshness/edition check is due
claim_publication_states.contradicted_or_unresolved: conflicting evidence exists; client must show unresolved state or withhold definitive wording

high_safety_gate.rule: High-safety content may render only as bounded awareness/internal non-authorization language unless the external claim has adequate primary/qualified evidence, required review, and applicability qualifiers.
unsupported_view_action: Split internal product-policy boundaries from external factual/legal assertions.
Allow internally authoritative non-authorization wording only when labeled Crew Blueprint policy/boundary.
Keep external legal, technical, manufacturer, credential, jurisdictional or quantitative statements blocked/partial until supported.
